points.description: Names a first correct use of a laser from the model answer, using its technical name: cutting, welding, medical surgery, optical fibre communication, or laser printing.
Names a second, different correct use of a laser from the model answer, using its technical name (from the same list), and not repeating the first use.

rubric.notes: Full marks need two different uses, each named precisely from the model answer list: cutting, welding, medical surgery, optical fibre communication, or laser printing. Vague or general wording such as "printing", "surgery" used loosely, "communication" or "industry" earns nothing, and a repeated use counts only once. A wrong use (for example "laser TV" or "measuring temperature") given as one of the two answers costs that point, so a student who gives one correct use and one wrong use gets 1 mark, and a student with no correct use gets 0.
